summaryZh: BOAT 研究组研究大气与海洋界面的小尺度物理过程，关注流体力学、物理海洋学和边界层气象中的问题。团队利用高性能计算开发基于物理与数据驱动的模型，并探索天气预报、可再生能源和海洋基础设施应用。
researchQuestions: 大气与海洋界面的小尺度物理过程如何运作？
topics: 流体力学与物理海洋学
methods: 物理模型与数据驱动模型

B ring O cean and A tmosphere T ogether (BOAT)

The main theme of t he BOAT group is to understand the small-scale physical processes at the atmosphere–ocean interface. With the help of modern high-performance computers, we develop physics-based and data-driven models to gain insights into the lively air–sea processes. Our studies not only focus on the fundamental scientific problems in fluid mechanics, physical oceanography, and boundary layer meteorology, but also have great implications in engineering applications including weather forecasting, renewable energy harvesting, and marine infrastructure protection .
